title: Lead Fraud Data Scientist
description: About Us At Félix, we\'re building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before. We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn\'t just about the numbers; it\'s a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavour Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high-performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission-serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users\' lives better. We are building the future, today. About The Role As a Lead Data Scientist for our Fraud team, you will be on the front lines of protecting our company and our customers. You will leverage your expertise in machine learning, statistics, and data analysis to design, build, and deploy sophisticated models that detect and prevent fraudulent activity in real-time. This is a high-impact role where you will see your work directly translate into protecting millions of dollars and ensuring a trustworthy platform for our users. Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Strategy: Define the long-term machine learning strategy for the fraud team, establish technical best practices, and mentor junior data scientists. End-to-End Model Development: Own the entire lifecycle of fraud detection models, from data exploration and feature engineering to model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Credit & Lending Fraud Mitigation: Design and develop models specifically targeted at lending fraud typologies, including synthetic identity fraud, first-party loan default fraud, and application fraud. Advanced Analysis: Conduct deep-dive investigations into emerging fraud patterns and user behavior, using clustering, outlier detection, network analysis, and other unsupervised techniques to uncover hidden risks and organized fraud rings. Experimentation: Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of new models, rules, and strategies on both fraud detection rates and user experience. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to translate business needs into data science solutions, seamlessly integrate ML scores with rule engines, and communicate complex results to non-technical audiences. Productionalize Models: Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models in a cloud environment, ensuring high availability and performance. Reporting & Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards using tools like Tableau or Looker to track key performance indicators (KPIs) like fraud loss rates, false positive rates, and model performance. Requirements Must-Haves Experience: 5+ years of experience in a hands-on data science role, building and deploying machine learning models. Leadership: Proven experience leading complex data science projects from inception to production, including setting technical direction and guiding peers. Python: Expert-level Python for data analysis and modeling (pandas, scikit-learn, etc.). SQL: Advanced SQL skills for complex data extraction and manipulation. Machine Learning Modeling: Deep experience with tree-based ML models (XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM) and statistical models (Logistic Regression, Lasso/Ridge). Model Explainability & Ethics: Deep understanding of model explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and algorithmic fairness to ensure models comply with credit lending regulations. Sampling Techniques: Strong understanding of sampling techniques for handling highly imbalanced datasets. Unsupervised Learning: Practical experience with clustering and outlier detection techniques (e.g., K-Means, K Nearest Neighbors, Isolation Forest). Model Lifecycle & Cloud: Proven experience with the full modeling lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and maintenance on a cloud platform like GCP, AWS, or Azure. Analytical Rigor: A solid foundation in statistics and experience designing and analyzing A/B tests. Communication: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Advanced English level. Nice to have Domain Experience: Direct experience in a FinTech, payments, or risk/fraud-focused role, particularly with exposure to credit or consumer lending. Alternative & Bureau Data: Experience working with traditional credit bureau data (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion) and alternative credit/identity data sources. Graph ML: Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph analytics tools (e.g., Neo4j, NetworkX) to map complex fraud networks. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with consumer lending regulations (e.g., FCRA, ECOA) and their impact on machine learning model development. MLOps: Hands-on MLOps experience (e.g., CI/CD for models, versioning, automated retraining). GCP / Vertex AI: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially Vertex AI. Spanish and/or Portuguese speaker These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About The Role As a Product Operations Specialist focused on Fraud Operations Processes, you will not just execute risk policies—you will be the architect of how our fraud operations scale. In a hyper‑growth fintech environment moving millions of dollars over WhatsApp, efficiency, speed, and accuracy are paramount. Your mission is to own, audit, and optimize our entire Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) library, bridging the gap between risk management, product capability, and operational execution. You will map out, fix and scale complex workflows, identify automation opportunities alongside Engineering and Product, and package high‑volume processes so they are ready to be seamlessly executed and ready to stop fraud while ensuring the legitimate user experience. Your ultimate goal is to build bulletproof, invisible guardrails that mitigate fraud while ensuring a frictionless user journey for legitimate customers recovering from false declines. Responsibilities SOP Architecture & Process Scalability: Maintain, continuously improve, and own the single source of truth for all live fraud operational processes. Standardize and document high‑volume workflows into clear, repeatable, step‑by‑step processes that can be executed consistently by any team member with minimal ramp‑up or oversight. Governance & Audit Cadence: Design and execute internal monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and spot‑checks for core processes to ensure compliance, maintain high quality, and significantly improve user journey. Process Metrics & KPIs: Define, track, and optimize key health metrics for fraud workflows, including process adherence, operational throughput, and process quality. Automation & Tooling Improvement: Identify systemic operational bottlenecks, build data‑driven business cases for automation, and partner directly with Product Ops and Engineering to implement tools that eliminate manual overhead. Change Control & Strategic Alignment: Own versioning, sign‑off, and cross‑functional communication whenever a process evolves. Partner closely with Workforce Management (WFM), Quality and Training to ensure updates are instantly reflected in capacity models and training calibrations. User Experience Safeguarding: Ensure that while minimizing fraud risk, the user recovery journey is seamless, minimizing friction when legitimate users face false declines. Requirements Fraud/Payments Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of financial fraud risk vectors and known patterns. SOP & Process Engineering: Proven track record of mapping, documenting, and scaling complex operational workflows within high‑growth fintechs or tech environments. Automation & Outsourcing Mindset: Experience prepping operational processes for automation or external vendors, with a sharp eye for separating high‑judgment tasks from transactional ones. Data Fluency: Strong hands‑on experience querying data (SQL, BigQuery, Omni, or similar) to extract process metrics, build operational dashboards, and back up business cases with hard numbers. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills to align cross‑functional teams including Customer Operations, WFM, Product, Quality Assurance, and multiple stakeholders. Autonomy under Ambiguity: A true "owner" mentality with a strong bias for action, capable of navigating and creating structure out of unstructured startup environments. Language Proficiency: Professional fluency and advanced communication skills in English. title: Coordenador(a) de Tributos Indiretos e Suporte às Operações
description: Contexte et environnement Trabalho sob pressão. Ambiente fiscal complexo, oneroso e instável. Alto nível de controles manuais – é necessária a otimização dos processos e controles. Activités O(a) empregado(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de SMS (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, tendo em vista a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos naturais, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia. Liderar a revisão e adaptação de processos tributários, controles e configurações do ERP para garantir conformidade com o novo modelo de tributação indireta; Apoiar testes, validações e implementações de alterações sistêmicas necessárias para atendimento aos requisitos da Reforma Tributária; Avaliar e apoiar as Joint Ventures em relação à transferência e movimentação de materiais; Avaliar e apoiar a equipe de SCLC quanto aos procedimentos tributários a serem adotados por fornecedores e contratados para emissão de notas fiscais e às cláusulas tributárias a serem utilizadas nos contratos; Avaliar e apoiar agentes de carga (Freight Forwarders) e equipes de Comércio Exterior/Aduana na análise de processos de importação, especialmente aqueles beneficiados pelo REPETRO ou outros regimes especiais; Colaborar com a equipe SAP no desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e customização de processos e funcionalidades do ERP relacionados à área tributária; Apoiar a equipe Comercial nas operações de óleo e gás envolvendo Ship-to-Ship, Loan in Kind e vendas, por meio dos processos de emissão de notas fiscais; Coordenar a análise, categorização e escrituração das notas fiscais realizadas pelos analistas; Monitorar transferências e movimentações simbólicas de materiais e equipamentos em projetos de E&P (Exploração e Produção), coordenando com as equipes de SCLC, Logística, Finanças e SAP para assegurar a precisão das informações fiscais; Atuar como ponto de contato com fornecedores em relação aos procedimentos de conformidade tributária ligados aos requisitos de faturamento, conforme solicitado pelas equipes de Tributos Indiretos e SCLC; Coordenar solicitações junto à equipe SAP relativas a melhorias tributárias e atualizações legislativas que impactem os processos Procure-to-Pay (P2P); Definir e validar parametrizações fiscais no SAP para novas transações de negócios e participar das atividades de testes em ambientes de qualidade e pré-produção; Monitorar e avaliar os impactos tributários decorrentes de atualizações do ERP e de novas versões do SAP; Avaliar e implementar soluções tributárias complementares integradas ao ambiente ERP da Companhia, incluindo Mastersaf e outras ferramentas de compliance. Responsabilidades (Accountabilities) O cargo é responsável por: Garantir que todas as medidas necessárias sejam adotadas para a emissão tempestiva de notas fiscais em conformidade com a legislação tributária; Identificar a Nota Fiscal adequada para cada movimentação ou transferência específica, de acordo com a legislação aplicável; Assegurar a consistência dos critérios adotados nos diversos tipos de transações da Companhia; Identificar riscos e problemas nos processos Procure-to-Pay (P2P) que possam gerar impactos tributários e comunicá-los prontamente ao Gerente Tributário; Propor medidas para mitigar riscos e seus respectivos impactos; Interagir com as áreas de SCLC, Logística, Finanças, Comercial e Operações para otimizar os processos de emissão de notas fiscais; Propor melhorias nos processos atuais e buscar maior eficiência nos processos P2P. Profil du candidat Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas ou áreas equivalentes; Pelo menos 10 anos de experiência na área/departamento tributário (experiência no setor de Óleo & Gás será altamente valorizada); Sólido conhecimento da legislação tributária, com foco em tributos indiretos; Experiência no uso de sistemas financeiros e soluções fiscais (Mastersaf ou sistemas tributários similares), bem como SAP; Informations supplémentaires TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente Geral - Casa & Gourmet Shopping

About The Role This role is a senior individual contributor on the GitHub Governance team, sharing technical ownership of the platform's surface with the existing senior engineers. The role is hands‑on and execution-heavy: shipping platform changes, building automation, partnering with InfoSec on IAM and Datasec design decisions, and contributing senior judgment to the team's most exposed work. The role operates with autonomy, owning problems end‑to‑end, making technical calls within their scope without waiting for direction, and knowing when to elevate versus move forward. What The Person Will Own As a Senior Software Engineer you will work across the team's portfolio, owning the slices that fit their depth and partnering on the rest. The current portfolio includes KPMG audit response and evidence collection, EMU migration (user‑profile migration is the active Wave 1, with the Identity Hub workaround as the path forward), rollouts including Copilot Code Review, vibe‑coding profile work and the connected guardrails, the inactivity‑rule design, and IP control mechanisms. Beyond execution, you will be a senior voice in the team's design discussions: architecture decisions, integration patterns with Identity Hub, ITSec/IAM/Datasec touchpoints, and the cross‑pack discussions with Coding Tools, AI Enablement, and Enterprise Solutions. This role will also serve as a technical partner in shaping the team's GitHub platform strategy, working alongside the PM to evaluate GitHub's product roadmap, anticipate how upcoming features affect Nubank's governance model. Proficiency with the GitHub API and automation via GitHub Actions, including building or maintaining CODEOWNERS structures and branch protection patterns at scale. Working knowledge of GitHub audit logs and the ability to trace a policy decision through to its downstream effects on users, repositories, audit trails, and connected systems. Every day, we – Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into turning Wärtsilä's purpose of enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality. Our ultimate aim is to provide increased value to both our customers and society. New, game-changing ideas and continuous improvement have been part of our DNA since 1834. Together, we can create new business opportunities and more sustainable future that we can all be proud of. We want to transition the world towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. By pushing the boundaries of engineering and technology, we can make it work. We are always on the lookout for future-oriented talent – want to join the ride? Wärtsilä Energy Business is looking for a Legal Counsel to join its Energy Services legal team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Other Wärtsilä locations in South or Central America are also negotiable. Energy Services provides lifecycle services and solutions to power plant owners globally. As a Legal Counsel in the Energy Services legal team you will handle various types of legal and compliance matters in relation to the Energy Services business. You will also contribute to the development of new business and concepts, including developments related to decarbonisation services. In this position, you will be part of a global legal team and report to the Head of Legal, Energy Services in Wärtsilä Energy Business. The preferred location is Rio de Janeiro. Main Responsibilities Providing commercially oriented and solution based legal support and compliance advice to the business in a variety of business matters. Review, negotiate, draft and advise on various types of transactions and commercial contracts. Support the business in the development and implementation of business models and concepts. Support compliance and governance management in the business. Manage claims and disputes. Provide training to the business on relevant legal and compliance issues. Actively participate in the development and implementation of policies, work processes and templates What do we expect from you? Education: A law degree from an accredited law school. Member with the relevant local Bar Association (or equivalent). B. Experience and Competences: Strong experience in either an in-house or a private practice role. Experience from the energy sector is a plus. Relevant experience that includes corporate and commercial transactions in an international setting, including experience from developing contracting models, structuring cross-border projects and long-term service agreements and customer interactions. Excellent command of English, Portuguese and Spanish, both written and oral. Other skills: Excellent negotiation and influencing skills coupled with commercial acumen and strategic thinking. Solid drafting, presentation and communication skills Business and customer mindset with ability to see the big picture and where one can best add value for the business Can-do attitude combined with an innovative mindset and willingness to challenge the status quo Team oriented with a positive attitude Ability to work in a multi-cultural organisation and virtual teams Readiness to travel. Why you and why us? This position offers a concrete possibility to contribute to the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. You will be a part of a global organization with local presence and work in an exciting and dynamic working environment with highly motivated and skilled colleagues. We offer interesting and challenging work as well as personal and professional development possibilities in a dynamic team. Last application date: 26/08/2026 At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities. Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country. This is Wärtsilä Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on #J-18808-Ljbffr

Até aqui, temos nos mostrado competentes no alcance e superação dos resultados, em todos os campos: Econômico-financeiro, de tecnologia, de imagem e, sobretudo, de patrimônio Humano. title: Jr. Graphic Designer
description: Vida Shoes International is seeking a passionate, creative and motivated Jr. Graphic Designer to help strengthen the overall brand presence of our Vida Kids brands (Stride Rite, Saucony, Merrell, Kurt Geiger, Andre Assous, Bruno Magli, Munro, Jambu, BCBG GIRLS, XOXO, Carter’s, and OshKosh B’gosh). You will work alongside a cross-discipline marketing team with expertise ranging from creative, digital, strategy, and execution. This role supports marketing with everything from design concept to implementation for specific brands and works closely with the e-commerce team to bring a collaborative vision to life in the marketplace. Daily responsibilities will include executing on creative briefs for visual assets for seasonal-based campaigns, selling tools, competitive research and production of approved design work. Monthly Compensation : $5,800 BRL - $7,250 BRL Designer will report to senior graphic designer. Must work EST (New York) business hours. The designer will work on a variety of assets including (but not limited to) Digital homepage & email assets, seasonal catalogs, social content, in-store fixture displays and graphics, PowerPoint presentations, showroom design, packaging, and advertisements: Execute marketing and promotional creative across multiple footwear and lifestyle brands. Update and manage email campaigns using established templates and design systems. Design & create sale assets, website banners, landing page graphics, and digital marketing materials. Adapt campaign creative across email, digital, social, and wholesale channels. Design and update wholesale presentations, line sheets, catalogs, and retailer-facing materials. Support seasonal product launches and promotional campaigns with timely creative execution. Collaborate closely with the Senior Designer to bring creative direction and brand strategy to life. Partner cross-functionally with Digital and Wholesale teams to support business initiatives and sales objectives. Maintain brand consistency across all creative deliverables and customer touchpoints. Prepare production-ready files for both digital and print applications. Organize and maintain creative assets, templates, and file management systems. Assist with image editing, retouching, asset resizing, and other production design needs. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Ensure all creative assets are accurate, on-brand, and aligned with business goals. Requirements : Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in graphic or brand design. Strong attention to detail and ability to work within established brand guidelines. Ability to take creative feedback and execute revisions efficiently. Comfortable working on a high volume of projects across multiple brands. Fluent in writing and speaking English. Strong portfolio that showcases both print and digital skillset. Skills : FIGMA a must. AI platforms is a plus. High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop. Microsoft PowerPoint experience. Animation skills are a plus. Strong understanding of design principles for type, shape, color and photography with attention to detail. Thank you in advance for your interest in this opening. Vida Shoes International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. At this time, only qualified candidates will be contacted. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Estágio em Recursos Humanos - Rio de Janeiro - 2026
description: Você gostaria da oportunidade de estagiar em uma empresa Global de Energia e Tecnologia? Você gosta de embarcar em projetos desafiadores? Venha fazer parte do nosso Programa de Estágio! Nosso Programa de Estágio foi desenvolvido para permitir que estudantes de Ensino Superior tenham a oportunidade de vivenciar experiências práticas de trabalho formando uma base sólida para suas vidas profissionais. Ao longo do programa, você terá percepções de primeira mão sobre os processos, sistemas e práticas que estão alinhados para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas por meio de execução impecável e aplicação de tecnologia de ponta. Esteja ao lado dos melhores Durante o estágio, você receberá a oportunidade de participar de treinamentos técnicos e de desenvolvimento, reuniões de equipe e participar de projetos para apresentar seus resultados. Além disso, contará com o suporte da equipe, gestão e um Buddy designado especialmente para suas necessidades, garantindo que você tenha uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa! Como estagiário, você será responsável por: Receber treinamento e mentoria, que permitirão que você complete suas tarefas e projetos que aperfeiçoarão seu aprendizado e habilidades; Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando-se à; Participar e entregar projetos internos para entregar resultados aos clientes (internos e externos) e identificar oportunidades de melhorias no negócio e área; Aprender o Sistema Operacional interno (incluindo softwares e aplicativos) que te ajudarão no processo de desenvolver e entregar seus projetos e tarefas diárias; Colaborar e conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global; Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio-Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável; Participar e engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros HUBs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo. Alimente sua paixão: Para ter sucesso e ser considerado no nosso estágio, você precisa: Estar regularmente matriculado em cursos de: Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Economia, Relações Internacionais, LEANI (Língues Estrangeiras Aplicadas à Negociações Internacionais) e Recursos Humanos; Possuir Inglês Avançado e/ou Fluente; Ter disponibilidade para estagiar pelo período de 02 anos, 30h por semana; Possuir o direito de estagiar legalmente no Brasil. Linha do Tempo do Processo Seletivo: O nosso Programa de Estágio funciona em ciclos de contratação, e você está participando do ciclo de Novembro! Dessa forma, o processo seletivo ocorrerá de: Agosto a Outubro. Após a realização da sua candidatura, o time de recrutamento fará a triagem dos currículos e, caso o seu perfil seja selecionado, você seguirá para a etapa de Entrevista Digital. Na sequência, as entrevistas serão avaliadas e, se houver avanço no processo, lhe convidaremos para uma entrevista com a gestão da área. Os candidatos aprovados nesta etapa receberão, então, a oferta para integrar o Programa de Estágio no ciclo previsto. Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação: Dentro da Baker Hughes temos diversas áreas de oportunidade para estagiar, então confira abaixo mais detalhes para a área de Recursos Humanos: Centro de Serviços de RH: Como Estagiário do Centro de Serviços de RH, você trabalhará na equipe do Centro Global de Serviços Compartilhados de RH que apoia a América do Norte e América Latina e se reportará ao Líder do Centro Compartilhado de RH. Você fornecerá o suporte a solicitações relacionadas a RH, como consultas gerais de políticas e ações relacionadas ao ciclo de vida dos funcionários. Promovemos uma cultura focada na excelência da experiência do funcionário e na melhoria contínua do processo, fornecendo suporte "Best in Class" e aconselhando sobre perguntas/solicitações simples e complexas de funcionários, líderes e/ou parceiros de RH. Você terá a oportunidade de apoiar a equipe na execução de projetos estratégicos, no cumprimento de prazos, na análise de dados e na elaboração de relatórios, contribuindo diretamente para o fortalecimento dos processos internos da organização. Durante o estágio, você contará com o apoio da equipe e do seu gestor, que garantirão uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa. Você receberá orientação e mentoria para concluir tarefas e projetos, desenvolvendo suas habilidades técnicas e profissionais. Além disso, terá a oportunidade de se familiarizar com os negócios e a cultura da Baker Hughes, bem como com nosso forte compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Localização Confira a localização da vaga no momento da sua candidatura, já que temos diferentes escritórios espalhados entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia. Formas de Trabalho Nós sabemos que todos são diferentes e que a maneira de trabalhar e entregar resultados no seu melhor é diferente para cada um. Na Baker Hughes, temos diferentes ambientes de trabalho, que dependem da localização e área de atuação. Sendo um estágio, ofertamos os Modelos Presencial e Híbrido, focando em um desenvolvimento mais amplo, diverso e rodeado de oportunidades para Networking, além de suporte direto da liderança. Abaixo, confira as 3 opções possíveis de horário de estágio disponíveis pela Baker Hughes, para que você possa ajustar o horário de acordo com a sua grade curricular: De 08h às 15h; De 09h às 16h; Ou de 10h às 17h. Working with us Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious and collaborative. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi‑year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Lead organization‑wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API‑level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per‑authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must‑have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi‑year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice‑to‑have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. description: Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. Job Description The Global Performance Marketing Manager - B2B will be responsible for paid advertising channels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant upcoming channels) that drive our B2B growth in our mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. You will strengthen our paid marketing team with your deep expertise in paid ads channels and your ability to think analytically and creatively. This is a hands‑on role that combines strategic thinking with day‑to‑day campaign ownership. You will oversee a multi‑million euro annual paid media budget across multiple markets, products and customer segments, while collaborating closely with cross‑functional stakeholders. Success in this role will be driven primarily by your ability to develop strategy, work full‑funnel, solve complex performance challenges, and execute at a high level. How will you make an impact? Be the global subject matter expert and owner for paid advertising in lead generation at Docplanner, especially in Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn Ads Make sure we are generating the highest possible volume of leads from paid marketing channels while ensuring lead quality and staying within budget and CPA goals Provide data‑driven guidance to content and design teams on creative concepts, messaging, formats, and offers Set up structured creative tests and turn insights into scalable best practices Proactively identify creative opportunities and drive a strong pipeline of new assets across markets Manage and develop paid marketing specialists across different markets, providing guidance, feedback, and support in their daily work Identify and implement AI‑powered workflows to reduce manual, repetitive tasks and enable teams to operate more efficiently at scale Serve as strategic advisor and mentor for your direct reports and other team members on matters related to paid ads Forecast, set, and monitor pacing for the channel budgets in consultation with local marketers to ensure all stakeholders have an overview of spending Develop new hypotheses for how to improve paid advertising approach and work with paid marketing specialists across local teams to implement tests based on them Together with stakeholders from marketing operations, lead generation, and marketing analytics, regularly analyse performance of paid marketing campaigns and recommend improvements to campaigns based on insights generated Support junior paid marketing specialists in their skill and knowledge development while not being afraid to “get your hands dirty” with day‑to‑day work Proactively bring solutions to improve processes and workflows as budgets and the organisation grow Qualifications Deep paid marketing experience with 6-8+ years managing paid ads campaigns hands‑on, ideally in international high‑growth or performance agency environments An opinion and point of view when it comes to topics like: hooks, ad formats, and making the connection between ads that attract attention and ads that convert A proven track record in managing and executing paid marketing strategies that have a direct impact on company revenue Strong analytical and reporting skills to connect campaign, funnel, and business metrics in order to identify opportunities and root causes of underperformance Experience using AI to analyze performance trends, generate testing hypotheses, and uncover growth opportunities Ability to give feedback, structure priorities, and help others grow Familiarity with modern targeting strategies and automation in the ad platforms - while still using tried and true techniques for ad optimization A strategic thinker who enjoys hands‑on execution Strong project management skills with ability to work cross functionally, manage, implement and analyse various initiatives in a fast‑paced environment Strong level of business English and secondary language amongst the following would be a plus: Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, Polish What To Expect From Our Hiring Process Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment). Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. Business Case – A take‑home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real‑life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings. Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team. References & Offer! Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects. A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. title: Lead AI Engineer — Productivity Systems
description: About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role We are looking for an engineer who has already built with AI in production. You have shipped LLM-powered systems (agents, copilots, RAG pipelines, or AI-driven automations), you know what breaks when they meet real users, and you know how to make them reliable enough for business-critical workflows. Your day-to-day is applied AI engineering: designing agentic workflows, integrating LLMs into internal tools and business processes, building evaluation and guardrail layers, and turning manual, high-friction workflows into AI-assisted ones that thousands of Nubankers depend on. This is not an infrastructure role. You will not spend your days on Terraform, IAM policies, or email deliverability. Cloud fluency helps, but the core of this job is the AI layer - prompts, context, agents, evaluations, integrations - and the product judgment to know where AI genuinely helps versus where deterministic automation is the right answer. Key Responsibilities Applied AI & Agentic Systems Design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows that automate complex internal processes end-to-end. Work hands-on with frontier models and the modern AI stack: tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, RAG, multi-agent orchestration. Own the full lifecycle of an AI system: from problem discovery and prototype to production hardening, monitoring, and iteration. Evaluation & Reliability Build evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and quality feedback loops so AI systems can be trusted in production - not just demoed. Define what "good" looks like for non-deterministic systems and instrument it: evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review where it matters. Intelligent Workflow Automation Use orchestration platforms (e.g., n8n) and custom integrations as delivery vehicles for AI-in-the-loop automation across business units. Integrate enterprise platforms (Slack, Google Workspace, Jira, internal APIs) into coherent, AI-assisted workflows. AI Adoption & Governance Drive the technical strategy for AI adoption within engineering and business workflows. Develop governance frameworks that make AI coding assistants and agents safe, compliant, and effective - balancing developer freedom with security and operational risk. Multiplier Work Create Golden Paths, reference implementations, and documentation that let other teams build AI workflows safely on their own. For Lead/IC6: act as the technical reference for applied AI in the domain, influence architecture beyond the immediate team, mentor senior engineers, and partner with ITSec and Privacy to align AI solutions with company policy. For Senior/IC5: execute complex AI projects with high autonomy, identify workflow bottlenecks worth automating, and mentor mid-level engineers. What are we looking for? Must Have - Demonstrated Applied AI Experience Shipped LLM systems in production: at least one real system with an LLM at its core - an agent, copilot, RAG application, or AI-driven automation - used by real users, not a proof of concept. Hands-on AI engineering: practical fluency with prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent frameworks or orchestration patterns. Evaluation mindset: experience measuring and improving AI output quality - evals, test sets, feedback loops - and an honest understanding of failure modes (hallucination, drift, prompt injection). Solid software engineering foundation: proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or Clojure; strong API and integration skills; the discipline to ship maintainable systems, not notebooks. AI product sense: the judgment to identify which problems deserve an LLM, which need deterministic automation, and which should not be automated at all. Nice to Have Experience with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, or custom orchestration engines). Exposure to cloud services (AWS) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with AI developer tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and AI governance practices. Behavioral & Strategic Skills Builder bias: you prototype fast, validate with real users, and harden what works. Governance-aware: you understand that "efficiency" must be balanced with "security", and you can design AI systems that are safe by default without destroying velocity. Multiplier: you enjoy documenting your work, creating Golden Paths, and teaching others how to use what you build. Comfortable with ambiguity: AI capabilities shift monthly; you treat that as an opportunity to re-solve problems better, not as churn. Practical knowledge of metadata management: tagging schemas, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, or ontology design. Understanding of data security/sensitivity classification frameworks and how they map to access control in a lakehouse environment. title: Senior Security Engineer (Blockchain Security)
description: About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. Our mission is to support the security of Nu's crypto operation. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow. As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale. You’ll be responsible for Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations. Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle. Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling. Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect. Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products. Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations. Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI‑assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI‑first security engineering looks like. Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must have Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response). Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security‑by‑design reviews. Hands‑on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off‑the‑shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine). Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert‑level depth not required, but real familiarity is). Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them. Experience with security frameworks such as OWASP and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). Fluency with AI‑assisted engineering: using coding agents and LLMs in daily work, with good judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how to review their output critically. Familiarity with AWS, and solid grounding in operating systems, networks, databases, and infrastructure architecture. Ability to work autonomously and proactively, strong analytical/problem‑solving skills, and clear written and spoken English for technical and non‑technical audiences. Nice to have Deeper knowledge of blockchain/crypto internals: consensus algorithms, cryptographic protocols, smart contracts. Experience auditing smart contracts (e.g. Solidity) or working with DeFi protocols. Experience integrating with third‑party crypto custody/infrastructure providers (e.g. Fireblocks, Circle, and similar). Exposure to regulatory or compliance requirements in a financial or crypto context. Experience with bug bounties and/or CTFs. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or Certified Blockchain Security Professional. title: Analista Performance e Gestão PL
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. title: Profissional Consultor Ciências de Dados

Explorar a base glosado versus não glosado e identificar hotspots, padrões recorrentes e diferenças relevantes entre perfis aceitos e glosados. Desenvolver análises de Pareto e segmentações por operadora, unidade, especialidade, procedimento, motivo, etapa da jornada e tempo entre eventos. Definir KPIs e conduzir validações in-sample e out-of-sample, avaliando desempenho, explicabilidade, reprodutibilidade, generalização, vieses, falsos positivos e falsos negativos. Traduzir padrões em tipologias operacionais e drivers acionáveis, conectando-os a intervenções de processo, regras, checagens, alertas ou automação. Quantificar impacto potencial e apoiar a priorização de iniciativas por valor evitável, frequência, recorrência, replicabilidade e esforço. Conduzir pesquisas aplicadas e provas de conceito, selecionando tecnologias e metodologias com critérios claros de aceite, continuidade e escalabilidade. Apoiar a integração e a evolução de modelos ou regras analíticas no fluxo operacional, definindo monitoramento, gatilhos de revisão e critérios de segurança. Trabalhar em conjunto com engenharia de dados, áreas de negócio, especialistas assistenciais e equipes de tecnologia para garantir consistência e aplicabilidade. Realizar inspeções de segurança nos locais de trabalho; Realizar inspeções estruturais; Acompanhar auditorias de clientes; Realizar treinamentos de segurança/integração para equipe operacional e gerentes de unidade; Acompanhar fiscalizações do Ministério do Trabalho; Acompanhar perícias de insalubridade e periculosidade em reclamações trabalhistas; Controlar o processo de implantação e manutenção da CIPA - Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes; Realizar o controle e gestão das documentações relativos à Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente; Garantir a correta aplicação do processo de EPI's da unidade; Garantir a implantação e entendimento do processo de avaliação de riscos; Apoiar o gestor da unidade na aplicação dos programas e campanhas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente. Exemplos: PREAXION, 'Tenha um dia seguro', 'Conversa do Dia', etc. Participar das investigações dos acidentes de trabalho, identificando as causas raízes, analisando e propondo medidas preventivas e corretivas, acompanhando as ações propostas até o seu encerramento, compartilhando as lições aprendidas; Participar de reuniões periódicas, contribuindo com as informações relativas à Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente. Nas unidades FOOD conhecer as regras de segurança dos alimentos e orientar a operação para atendimento das Boas Práticas de Manipulação de Alimentos sempre que necessário para prevenção de ocorrências alimentares; Nas unidades FOOD garantir que todos os programas HSE como PREAXION, Safety Nets, 3 Pontos para Segurança, Safety Walks, etc sejam aplicáveis com visão de segurança dos alimentos e segurança do trabalho, reforçando a cultura ZERO DTA e ZERO ACIDENTE; Ser responsável pela Saúde e Segurança, bem como aplicar as normas, procedimentos e diretrizes do Sistema de Gestão de Saúde e Segurança; DIMENSÕES - PRINCIPAIS KPIS Garantir o controle de indicadores de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente na sua unidade; Cumprimento de prazo; Qualidade dos retornos técnicos; Atenção aos requisitos legais na amplitude de suas responsabilidades; Atingimento das metas globais (ex.: LTIR, Safety Nets, etc.) #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Advogado | Recuperação de Crédito Bancário - RC
description: Job description Construa sua carreira em um dos maiores escritórios de Propriedade Intelectual da América Latina! Com 4 escritórios no Brasil e atuação em mais de 150 países , o Dannemann Siemsen é referência em Propriedade Intelectual na América Latina com 125 anos de tradição . Somos reconhecidos pela inovação e pela força de nosso time multidisciplinar , formado por profissionais que lideram suas áreas de atuação e têm seu talento reconhecido nos maiores rankings do Brasil e do mundo. Temos em nosso DNA o compromisso com a responsabilidade social . Participamos de projetos de inserção e capacitação de jovens no mercado de trabalho, temos um sólido Programa de Diversidade & Inclusão e criamos iniciativas que fortalecem promovem um ambiente inclusivo e criativo . Atuamos de forma abrangente em diferentes áreas do Direito, com destaque para nossa liderança em Propriedade Intelectual. Também oferecemos suporte especializado em Contencioso, Relações de Consumo, Contratos, Direito e Tecnologia, Direito da Publicidade, Regulatório, Compliance e Investigações Internas, além de Avaliação de Ativos Intelectuais . Além de nossa reconhecida atuação em Propriedade Intelectual — abrangendo marcas, patentes, direitos autorais, desenhos industriais e segredos de negócio — oferecemos suporte jurídico qualificado em diversas áreas do Direito, como Contencioso Cível e Empresarial, Mediação e Arbitragem, Relações de Consumo, Contratos, Direito e Tecnologia, Direito Regulatório, Compliance e Investigações Internas, Avaliação de Ativos Intelectuais entre outras. Somos mais de 180 profissionais especializados , com formações que vão do Direito à Engenharia, passando por áreas como Química e Farmacêutica . Estamos em constante atualização para acompanhar as transformações e as demandas do mercado, oferecendo soluções completas e inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Se você busca aprendizado, crescimento e a chance de atuar em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Main responsibilities Atuação em processos de recuperação crédito Bancário, desde a petição inicial até o encerramento; Elaboração de peças processuais, pareceres e relatórios jurídicos; Interface com clientes e partes envolvidas. Requirements and skills Formação completa em Direito com registro ativo na OAB; Experiência comprovada em recuperação de crédito bancário; Excelente redação jurídica e capacidade de negociação; Domínio de sistemas jurídicos e pacote Office. Boa comunicação oral e escrita; Organização, atenção aos detalhes e facilidade para trabalhar com documentos, sistemas e controles . Additional information Necessário experiencia na área em demandas de contencioso de massa - Relações de Consumo cliente Banco do Brasil. Vivência em escritórios especializados com atuação como advogado na área de recuperação de crédito Benefícios: Vale-Transporte; Vale-Refeição; Plano de Saúde; Seguro de Vida; TotalPass; Convênio com o Sesc. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Project Analyst - Oil and Gas
description: About dss+ At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects - you help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future. We are a purpose-led global consultancy partnering with organisations in high-risk and asset-intensive industries to solve complex operational challenges across safety, operational excellence, and sustainability. We combine deep expertise, practical problem-solving, and digital innovation to deliver measurable and lasting impact for our clients. Why This Role This is an opportunity to support high-impact projects within the Oil & Gas sector, working alongside experienced consulting teams and senior client stakeholders. You will play a critical role in project governance, performance tracking, and decision support, helping ensure successful execution of complex transformation and operational improvement initiatives. This role offers excellent exposure to strategic programs while developing core consulting, project management, and analytical capabilities. Oil & Gas – Why This Industry The Oil, Gas & Energy sector is undergoing significant transformation as it balances growing global demand with the transition to lower-carbon energy systems. At dss+, we help clients improve safety, optimise performance, and accelerate their sustainability and energy transition strategies. This is a key industry where we support organisations to navigate complexity and deliver long-term, sustainable impact. Your Impact at dss+ You will support the successful delivery of consulting engagements by helping project teams manage governance, track performance, monitor risks, and ensure alignment against strategic objectives. Working closely with project leaders and client stakeholders, you will provide data-driven insights, maintain project controls, and develop executive‑level materials that support effective decision‑making. Key Accountabilities Support project governance activities, ensuring effective control of schedules, risks, actions, and deliverables Consolidate and monitor project KPIs, developing reports and performance dashboards Perform data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement Develop high‑quality executive presentations and management reports for clients and project leadership Support project planning, tracking, and control activities across multiple workstreams Organize project meetings, document key decisions, and monitor follow‑up actions Maintain project documentation and ensure adherence to governance processes Contribute to the preparation of client deliverables and project status communications Promote discipline in project execution, ensuring deadlines, commitments, and deliverables are effectively managed Support continuous improvement initiatives, including the use of digital and AI‑enabled solutions What You’ll Experience at dss+ Deliver on our Purpose Be part of a values‑led organisation where your work helps save lives, improve performance, and advance sustainability for our clients and their people. Develop your Trusted Expertise Gain early autonomy and real accountability, working closely with senior clients on complex, high‑impact challenges. Thrive in a Culture of Respect Join an inclusive and collaborative environment where your voice is valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and your wellbeing is supported. Shape your Career Accelerate your development through hands‑on experience, structured learning, and opportunities to work on international projects. Who You Are You bring strong analytical thinking, a structured mindset, and the ability to work effectively in complex and fast‑paced environments. You are comfortable working with data, managing multiple priorities, and supporting stakeholders through clear communication and high‑quality deliverables. Experience Experience supporting projects, PMO activities, business analysis, or consulting engagements Experience developing reports, dashboards, and management presentations Exposure to project planning, governance, performance monitoring, or operational improvement initiatives Experience within consulting, industrial, energy, or asset‑intensive environments is advantageous Capabilities Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy Strong communication and stakeholder engagement capability Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Results‑oriented approach with a commitment to excellence in execution Technical Skills Advanced Excel, including data analysis, dashboards, and pivot tables Advanced PowerPoint with experience preparing executive‑level presentations Knowledge of project planning, governance, and project controls Experience with Power BI, MS Project, or similar project management and reporting tools is desirable Familiarity with AI‑enabled solutions and productivity tools is advantageous Education & Languages Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field Postgraduate qualification or certification in Project Management or Finance is advantageous Fluency in English required Mobility Willingness to travel as required Growth & Benefits We invest in your development and success through: Structured learning and development, including our Consulting Development Academy Mentorship from experienced leaders and industry experts Opportunities to contribute to international projects Competitive salary, performance‑based incentives, and comprehensive benefits Flexible working policies A Bit More About Us We are implementers and change‑makers. Our teams work from the boardroom to the shop floor, helping organisations build resilience, improve performance, and sustain results over time. Our expertise spans industries including metals and mining, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, and private equity — combining deep operational knowledge with transformation and capability‑building expertise. Diversity & Inclusion dss+ is committed to building a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, valued, and able to contribute fully. We believe diversity strengthens our organisation and drives better outcomes for our people, our clients, and the communities we serve. #LI-RS2 #J-18808-Ljbffr

Buscamos pessoas que gostem de investigar problemas, propor soluções, colocar ideias em prática e acompanhar o impacto gerado por suas entregas. title: Jr Manager | Business Insights New Latin America, Brazil, Rio de Janeiro
description: About Sony Music Entertainment Brazil Group Sony Music Entertainment Brazil Group is one of the country’s leading entertainment groups and part of the global Sony Music Entertainment network. Our mission is to drive music and culture forward by connecting artists and fans through innovation, creativity, and excellence in execution. We operate across all areas of the recorded music business, from developing new talent to enhancing an iconic catalog, always aiming to inspire and transform through music. The Business Intelligence (BI) area is responsible for transforming market, streaming, consumption, and revenue data into strategic information that supports decision-making across Negotiation, Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Finance, and company leadership. We are looking for a Jr Manager to lead the Forecasts & Performance function, directly contributing to the generation of strategic insights and business decision support. What you’ll do: Lead the Forecasts & Performance function within the Business Intelligence team; Manage and develop a team of 1 to 3 analysts; Lead forecasts for artist signings and contract renewals, as well as analyses related to label and catalog acquisitions; Develop financial models, feasibility analyses, and scenarios to support investment decisions; Structure, track, and communicate the company's key corporate KPIs and business performance indicators; Produce executive reports and presentations for leadership and stakeholders; Lead recurring performance and strategy forums with areas such as Commercial, Marketing, and A&R; Identify business opportunities, risks, and trends through data analysis; Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for business areas; Ensure quality, methodological consistency, and governance of the data used in analyses; Identify opportunities to automate and evolve the team's analytical processes. Requirements: Bachelor's degree completed in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or related fields; Advanced Excel skills for financial modeling and investment analysis; Strong ability to build executive reports and handle/analyze large volumes of data; Strong analytical thinking, executive communication, and storytelling with data; Ability to influence and build alignment across different areas, with strong stakeholder management; Sense of priority, organization, and leadership/team development skills; Advanced English (required); Spanish is a plus. Expected experience: Experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, Strategic Planning, FP&A, or related areas; Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario building; Track record of monitoring business performance and indicators; Experience leading presentations and discussions with senior stakeholders; History of close partnership with business areas such as Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Strategy, or Product; Prior experience with people management or leadership of multidisciplinary projects/squads; Knowledge of Python, Tableau, Looker, or cloud data environments (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar) is a plus; Knowledge of the music, streaming, and digital consumption market is a strong advantage; Experience with M&A processes, valuation, or asset assessment is a plus; Experience in media, music, entertainment, or digital industries is a strong advantage. What we give you: You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day; A modern environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork, empowering you to do your best work; Investment in your growth and professional development, enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community; Space to accelerate progress, innovate, and create what’s next; A platform to lead positive change, with opportunities to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives; A benefits package designed to support both you and your family, from wellness programs to paid time off that helps balance work and personal life; Time off during the year-end holiday season.
